metaDescription: Russian Blue vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Russian Blue boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: The Russian Blue core series (FVRCP plus rabies per law) is plotted at 8, 12, 16, 16 weeks in the table above so a medium kitten is covered as maternal antibodies fade.
At 7-12 lb (3-5.5 kg), Russian Blue visit logistics matter as much as antigens: book the 16-week appointment before class, daycare, or boarding asks for proof.
Bring dental disease and obesity if free-fed into the Russian Blue exam-room conversation while you are already there for shots.
Rabies for a Russian Blue still follows local statute, and when the clinic allows you can pair it with the ≥16-week core finish, then photograph the certificate into PetClues the same day.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Russian Blue shots when the kitten seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or dental disease worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Russian Blue make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Russian Blue antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Russian Blue dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this medium cat.
Reset the Russian Blue reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Russian Blue core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Russian Blue misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Russian Blue health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Russian Blue adult health guide for breed predispositions such as dental disease, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
